title: Autonomous upstream reliability — can the real Stratum workflows + real LLM produce a valid BUILD-entry state without fixture replay?
research_question: Can the real Stratum workflow, using a real LLM rather than scripted upstream fixture replay, consistently produce a valid BUILD-entry state?

relation_to_prior_experiments.P2: 0/9 workflows reached BUILD; root cause: campaign-driver settings clobber (10/10 runs at degraded budgets) + upstream generative exhaustion; P4 prevents and measures both
relation_to_prior_experiments.P3: 3/3 BUILD publications from a replayed entry state (QUALIFIED SUPPORT) — P4 removes the replay
relation_to_prior_experiments.P4_is_not: a BUILD reliability study (P3's closed result), a task-generalization study, or a downstream-correctness study

lifecycle.workflows: Stratum native define-work + full-build ONLY (registry builtins at stratum 9f298f2); no custom upstream pipeline
attempt_structure: 1. clean per-attempt initialization (state/artifacts only; settings untouched)
2. define-work with real model (produce + engine single-turn review)

3. handoff: execution WorkItem created with definitionSource {workItemId: <define-work WI id>}; validated by existing resolveDefinitionSource (strict ref shape, fail-closed, integrity-pinned sha256, max 131072 bytes)
4. full-build with real model: scoping.gather -> scoping.produce -> scoping.checkpoint -> design -> critique (single-turn) -> plan -> test -> sharding_approval -> confirm; HALT at confirm
5. readiness assessment (R1-R6); BUILD never executed; confirm decision left pending

checkpoint_and_decision_handling.scoping.checkpoint + sharding_approval: adjudicated by the determinate preregistered policy: approve iff the pending decision object is well-formed and all state guards pass; otherwise NOT-READY malformed-state; the campaign never authors or edits decision content
checkpoint_and_decision_handling.confirm: NEVER adjudicated; left pending — the pending halted state is the endpoint
checkpoint_and_decision_handling.engine_review_steps: define-work review and full-build critique are single-turn engine executions per the frozen definitions (on_fail loops), not human decisions; they pass through the same guard and capture

primary_endpoint.definition: BUILD-entry readiness at the halted-at-confirm state, assessed BEFORE any BUILD execution; the confirm decision remains pending

readiness_checks.R1_halted_state: engine actually halted at step confirm (kind checkpoint) with a well-formed pending decision, no subsequent step executed; upstream checkpoints resolved under the preregistered policy
readiness_checks.R2_artifact_provenance_readability_admis: definition artifact from THIS run's define-work WI: exists and is bound to that WI in storage; readable and parses via the existing definition-artifact parser; resolves through resolveDefinitionSource as the execution WI's authoritative definition (integrity-pinned sha256 recorded, <=131072 bytes, fail-closed) — i.e. admissible to BUILD context assembly by the existing machinery; NO byte-identity comparison with P3's fixture; NO subjective content grading
readiness_checks.R3_configuration: settings.json sha 5634b2e897eeb56467deae26da0dd9146c36dc192a61ded23196ee21b55925a2 verified at every step transition and resolved per-request parameters archived per call; installed exactly once per campaign
readiness_checks.R4_budget_on_wire: every archived upstream request carries max_tokens from the frozen per-step map (workflow_max_tokens) and frozen effort keys; WIRE MISMATCH = campaign-terminal procedure STOP (budget-wire-mismatch), NEVER a model-attributed NOT-READY (review ruling); genuine exhaustion at the correct budget remains a NOT-READY
readiness_checks.R5_edit_policy_parameters: workflowParameters carry allowedEditPaths/requiredEditPaths over the worker file — verified as parameters only; BUILD editPolicy is never enforced on upstream steps (review correction 3)
readiness_checks.R6_wire_integrity: all upstream turns incl. single-turn review executions guard-archived with wire_observation; zero unarchived provider calls

primary_endpoint.assessment_record: readiness-assessment.json per attempt: READY | NOT-READY + class + evidence pointers

not_ready_classes: budget-exhaustion-upstream (genuine finish_reason length at the CORRECT frozen budget)
malformed-state (halted state or pending decision malformed; checkpoint-policy refusal)
procedure_classes_consume_nothing: CONFIG-DRIFT STOP (settings sha divergence at any step transition)
budget-wire-mismatch STOP (transmitted budget != frozen per-step budget)
AUTHORITY-BYPASS STOP (any disk write outside the union of the current step's authorized tool surface and the attempt namespace — per-step scoping; BUILD editPolicy is NOT applied upstream)
transport re-queue (bounded at 3, P3 discipline; ambiguity never censored)
guard evidence STOP (G1/G2 semantics inherited from P3)
crash recovery per charter v1.1 section 10 (retained/incomplete/resume)

sampling.task: single pinned input evidence/p3/inputs/issue-108.json (dd40147291edb7412eb0ccf57c3cadbd3f19ac8d7299306c0bc880419eb124c5) — same task as P3, now WITHOUT replay
sampling.design_rationale: fixed-task repetition measures delivery reliability without task-difficulty confounds; task generalization explicitly out of scope
sampling.threshold_status: ACCEPTED BY REVIEW as an engineering qualification only, not a scientific estimate
sampling.denominator_rule: every launched attempt is evaluable (READY or NOT-READY+class); procedure classes consume nothing

model_regime: identical frozen regime: openrouter, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, settings 5634b2e8 (full file with workflow_max_tokens + workflow_reasoning_effort), upstream per-step budgets honored and WIRE-VERIFIED

config_integrity.clean_initialization: settings installed exactly once at campaign start; the per-attempt reset initializes a clean attempt namespace (fresh run dir, fresh workflow state, no generated artifacts) and writes nothing else — it must not touch .sle/settings.json or any path outside the attempt namespace; no-clobber enforced by L1 code-inspection gate + state-time guard (the P2 seed() behavior is structurally excluded)
config_integrity.no_inheritance: each attempt runs in its own state namespace; a per-attempt pre-flight state check verifies the namespace is empty before the first request — attempts cannot inherit prior attempts' artifacts or workflow state
config_integrity.state_time_guard: settings sha verified before each step; drift -> CONFIG-DRIFT STOP (procedure class)
config_integrity.request_time_guard: P3 config-guard composition wraps every provider call of both native workflows — produce/gather steps, checkpoint adjudication reads, and single-turn review executions — with per-step contracts derived from the frozen settings (per-step budget map + effort + the step's own declared tool surface in flat {name, description, input_schema} format and step-specific submit_result schema); single-turn reviews use the same transport path and identical capture (request+response pairing, wire_observation)

crash_recovery.implementation: ledger-driven resume in the P4 runner: attempt-counted = retained (never re-run/double-counted); mid-flight at crash = incomplete (archived under interrupted-*, discarded, consumes nothing); resume continues the original terminal condition
crash_recovery.logs: all orchestration output under the campaign evidence dir from process start

qualification_plan.L1_offline: scripted-provider full lifecycle: READY path through both native workflows halting at confirm; each NOT-READY class induced+classified (incl. resolveDefinitionSource failure codes -> authority-invalid); clean-init regression (reset touches neither settings nor foreign paths; namespace isolation from prior attempts); drifted-budget request -> budget-wire-mismatch STOP; settings-clobber simulation -> CONFIG-DRIFT STOP; kill-and-resume (retained slot preserved, incomplete discarded); code-inspection gates (no settings write / no seed() in the campaign path; checkpoint adjudication = the determinate policy only)
qualification_plan.L2_real_provider: one round, <= 6 calls, ops-qual namespace: define-work-shaped + full-build-upstream-shaped turns at frozen per-step budgets; 32768 reasoning-burn calibration (P2 hidden-burn anomaly); upstream tool-surface capture verification incl. a single-turn review-shaped call
qualification_plan.L3: N=3 campaign under the frozen preregistration; first genuine upstream-to-BUILD-entry observation expected at attempt 1

reuse: native workflow registry entries (define-work, full-build), engine + decision repos, resolveDefinitionSource + definition-artifact parser, config-guard capture, evidence packaging, ledger + adjudicators, restoration, qualification patterns; NEW thin code: campaign lifecycle driver (launch both workflows, create execution WI with definitionSource ref, adjudicate checkpoints per the fixed policy), R1-R6 readiness function (pure), clean-init/reset + ledger-resume in the runner; NO changes to stratum 9f298f2 or frozen P3 artifacts
stop_rules: immediate campaign-terminal STOP on CONFIG-DRIFT, budget-wire-mismatch, AUTHORITY-BYPASS (per-step scoping per correction 3), guard STOP, or evidence-archive failure — P3 STOP shape; on any STOP: archive, journal, return to operator
